_meta.description: The 'reasoning_provider' event: which reasoning backend the GROUND uses. Display only on a phone.

cloud_allowed.notes: Cloud allowed and configured on the ground (the fake key is not part of the payload).

cloud_allowed_no_key.notes: Cloud allowed by the operator but no Claude key on the ground: claude stays unavailable.

local_gemma_cloud_blocked.notes: The shipped default: local Gemma, cloud not allowed (cloud_allowed false); claude is listed in 'unavailable' with the reason to show.

unavailable.claude: Cloud reasoning is not enabled. Claude would send person crops and the reference photo to Anthropic; set FLIGHTRISK_ALLOW_CLOUD_LLM=1 to opt in.

off.notes: Reasoning off: provider 'off', label and model null.

unavailable.claude: Cloud reasoning is not enabled. Claude would send person crops and the reference photo to Anthropic; set FLIGHTRISK_ALLOW_CLOUD_LLM=1 to opt in.
